phase: Atomic D1 Insurance Lead Operating-State Executor
objective: Persist canonical insurance lead operating-state plans through one atomic D1 batch without duplicating transition policy in persistence.

writeShapes.noOp: Zero prepared statements and zero D1 batch calls.
writeShapes.stageOnly: One relationship upsert plus one immutable stage-changed relationship-event insert in the same D1 batch.
writeShapes.combined: Relationship upsert, insurance lead-profile upsert, and immutable stage-changed event insert in the same D1 batch.

atomicity.mechanism: Cloudflare D1 batch contract already used by quote-request persistence.
atomicity.rule: A stage change is never intentionally issued separately from its audit event.
atomicity.concurrency: INS-006S does not invent an optimistic-concurrency protocol that the existing relationship/profile persistence contracts do not atomically expose.
